Im Feld <i>„Schlagwörter“</i> in den Bri: In the “Tags” field in the letter details, separate several terms with commas, e.g., “Tax 2025, Insurance, urgent.” As you type, PDFMy suggests tags you have already used. When you file the document, they are recorded in the incoming mail log and in the PDF’s keywords – so Windows Search and other PDF programs can find the document too. In the incoming mail log you can filter by tag, and clicking a tag shows all documents with that tag; use “+ Tag” to add tags and “×” to remove them directly in the list.
